info.title: HandsFreeOS API
info.description: Every write goes through a command; every read through a query. Same operations for the web app, mobile, the assistant and integrations. The phone app sends x-hfos-client: mobile with x-hfos-app-version, and on every command x-hfos-command-id (a repeat gets the first answer back), x-hfos-occurred-at and x-hfos-sent-at (its own clock, corrected here), and x-hfos-confirmed-at after "Still send?". Every error body carries a disposition: final, retry or ask.

post.summary: Create your organization and its first workspace. You become Owner of both.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits organization.created, workspace.created.

post.summary: Add another business (workspace) to an organization you administer.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.create. Emits workspace.created, membership.created.

post.summary: Put yourself on a business in an organization you administer, as an owner. For one set up for a client and since taken on.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits membership.created.

post.summary: Change a workspace name, time zone, industry or settings.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.update. Emits workspace.updated.

post.summary: Delete a business and everything in it — customers, messages, calls, calendars, invoices, workflows, files and its history. Its phone numbers are released. This cannot be undone. Only an owner can do it, and they type the business’s name to confirm.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires workspace.delete. Emits workspace.deletion_requested.

post.summary: Invite someone to a workspace by email. They receive a single-use link that expires in 7 days.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires members.invite. Emits invitation.created.

post.summary: Send a pending invitation again with a fresh link; the old link stops working.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires members.invite. Emits invitation.resend_requested.

post.summary: Cancel a pending invitation so its link no longer works.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires invitations.revoke. Emits invitation.revoked.

post.summary: Accept an invitation link. Works once, for the email it was sent to.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits invitation.accepted, membership.created.

post.summary: Change a teammate's role in a workspace.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires members.change_role. Emits membership.role_changed.

post.summary: Remove a teammate from a workspace, or leave it yourself.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires workspace.read. Emits membership.removed.

post.summary: Make someone an owner of your organization (an agency and all its businesses). They must already own one of its businesses. Use it to hand an agency over before you leave.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires org.members.manage. Emits organization.owner_added.

post.summary: Update your own name, photo or preferences.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits user.profile_updated.

post.summary: Delete your own account. Your sign-in and your name are removed and you are signed out everywhere; the customers, messages and jobs you worked on stay with each business, shown as from a former teammate. A business’s only owner makes someone else an owner first.
post.description: Risk level 4. Emits account.deletion_requested, organization.owner_added.

post.summary: Say OK to what the Assistant does with your questions: what you ask about is sent to an AI service to answer you. One OK covers the web and the phone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits assistant.consented.

post.summary: Add a pipeline with its stages (the default template is New, Contacted, Estimate sent, Won, Lost).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits pipeline.created.

post.summary: Rename or reorder a pipeline.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits pipeline.updated.

post.summary: Archive a pipeline that has no open leads. The last active pipeline stays.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits pipeline.archived.

post.summary: Add a stage to a pipeline, at the end or right after another stage.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits stage.created.

post.summary: Rename a stage or change what it means (open, won or lost). Kind changes need an empty stage.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits stage.updated.

post.summary: Set the order of every stage in a pipeline.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits stage.reordered.

post.summary: Delete a stage. Leads in it move to another stage of the same kind.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits stage.deleted.

post.summary: Add a company. Warns when one with the same email, phone or name already exists; from the phone, adds it anyway and flags the likely duplicate.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits company.created. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Change a company’s details: only the ones edited, each with what the editor saw, and the newest change to each wins.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits company.updated. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Archive a company. Refused while it has open leads or tasks unless forced, which archives the leads too.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires records.archive. Emits company.archived. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Bring an archived company back.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits company.restored. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add a person. Warns when someone with the same email or phone already exists; from the phone, adds them anyway and flags the likely duplicate.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits person.created. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Change a person’s details: only the ones edited, each with what the editor saw, and the newest change to each wins. Changing the company also moves their open leads to it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits person.updated. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Archive a person. Refused while they have open leads or tasks unless forced, which archives the leads too.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires records.archive. Emits person.archived. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Bring an archived person back.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits person.restored. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add a tag to the workspace.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits tag.created.

post.summary: Rename or recolor a tag everywhere it is used.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires tags.manage. Emits tag.updated.

post.summary: Delete a tag and remove it from every record.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires tags.manage. Emits tag.deleted.

post.summary: Set the tags on a person, company or lead, or add or remove some and leave the rest (mode). People’s screens use record.add_tag and record.remove_tag.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits record.tags_changed.

post.summary: Put one tag on a person, company or lead. Already there, nothing changes; the other tags are left alone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits record.tags_changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Take one tag off a person, company or lead. Already off, nothing changes; the other tags are left alone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits record.tags_changed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add a lead for a person or company. It starts in the first open stage of the pipeline.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits lead.created. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Change a lead’s title, value, source, people, expected close date, assignee or next action: only what was edited, each with what the editor saw, and the newest change to each wins.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits lead.updated, lead.assigned. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Move a lead to another stage of its pipeline (and to a spot within it). A lost stage needs a reason.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits lead.stage_changed, lead.won, lead.lost, lead.reopened. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Set or clear the one thing to do next on a lead, and when. One set later than this (from the phone, say) stays.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits lead.next_action_set, lead.next_action_cleared. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Archive a lead so it leaves the pipeline without losing its history.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits lead.archived. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Bring an archived lead back to its stage.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits lead.restored. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add a task, optionally tied to a person, company or lead and assigned to someone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits task.created. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Change a task’s title, notes, due date, assignee or related records: only what was edited, each with what the editor saw, and the newest change to each wins.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits task.updated. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Mark a task done. Already done, nothing changes.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits task.completed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Reopen a completed task. Already open, nothing changes.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits task.reopened. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Delete a task you created (owners and admins can delete any).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits task.deleted. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Log a note, call or visit on a person, company or lead.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits activity.logged. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Edit a note, call or visit you logged.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits activity.updated.

post.summary: Delete a note, call or visit (yours, or any as an owner or admin).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits activity.deleted.

post.summary: Reserve a place for a file on a record. Upload to the returned path, then confirm. The phone names the file itself, so asking again for the same one returns the same place.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits . Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Mark an uploaded file ready once the object exists in storage.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits file.attached. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Remove a file from a record. The worker deletes the stored object afterwards.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits file.deleted.

post.summary: Reserve an import. Upload the CSV to the returned path, then start it with a column mapping.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.import. Emits .

post.summary: Start a reserved import with the column mapping and how to treat matches.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires records.import. Emits import.requested.

post.summary: Stop an import that is pending or running. Rows already imported stay.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.import. Emits import.cancelled.

post.summary: Buy the workspace’s business number from the search results. HandsFreeOS provisions it with the carrier; calls ring as soon as it is active.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.purchase_requested.

post.summary: Give the business number back to the carrier. Calls and texts to it stop, and it cannot be recovered.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.release_requested.

post.summary: Choose which phones ring with the browsers when a customer calls, how long they ring, and the voicemail greeting.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.routing_updated.

post.summary: Choose what forwarding phones show when a customer calls: the customer’s number, or the business number (so a phone that silences unknown callers still rings once the business number is a contact). Either way the phone hears who is calling before pressing 1.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.routing_updated.

post.summary: Choose which of a business’s numbers new conversations go out from.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.default_changed.

post.summary: Name one of a business’s numbers, so a list of them can be told apart.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.label_changed.

post.summary: Choose who a number rings. Nobody chosen means everyone with the inbox.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.members_changed.

post.summary: Quiet hours for texts and the reminder email when a customer waits for a reply.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone.settings_updated.

post.summary: Send the business details the carriers need before texts can go out: toll-free verification, or the 10DLC brand and campaign for a local number. After the carriers turn one down, send the corrected details again: a toll-free request is edited or replaced and a campaign is registered again. A local number’s business profile and brand are checked against what HandsFreeOS support corrected with the carriers, so changed details there apply to the campaign only.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits registration.submitted.

post.summary: Open the text or email conversation with a customer, starting it if needed.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.created, conversation.linked. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Mark a conversation read for the whole team.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.read. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Mark a conversation unread so it stands out in the inbox again.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.marked_unread. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Give a conversation to a teammate, or leave it for anyone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.assigned. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Hide a conversation until a set time. It comes back then, or sooner if the customer writes again.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.snoozed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Put a conversation away so it leaves the inbox. Its messages, calls and timeline stay; bring it back any time.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits conversation.archived. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Close a conversation that needs nothing more. A new message opens it again.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.closed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Close every one of this customer’s conversations, on every line.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.closed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Bring a closed or snoozed conversation back into the inbox.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.reopened. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Bring an archived conversation back, in the state it was in when it was put away.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits conversation.restored. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Tie a conversation from an unknown number or address to a customer. Earlier messages and calls join their timeline.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.linked. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Text, email or chat with a customer: a text from the business number, an email from a workspace address or a connected mailbox, or a reply in a website chat. Texts and emails are queued here and the worker sends them. A person writing in a conversation the AI teammate is answering takes it over.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires inbox.use. Emits message.queued, message.sent, message.scheduled, conversation.created, conversation.taken_over. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Send a text or email that did not go out one more time.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires inbox.use. Emits message.queued.

post.summary: Cancel a text waiting for quiet hours to end. It never goes, and leaves the conversation.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits message.schedule_cancelled. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Record that a customer asked not to be texted (or agreed to texts again) outside of a STOP or START text.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits person.opted_out, person.opted_in.

post.summary: Call a customer from the browser. Returns what the browser dials with; customers see the business number.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits call.started.

post.summary: Call a customer through your own cell: HandsFreeOS rings your verified cell from the business number, you press 1, and the customer is connected, seeing the business number. Recorded, and filed in the customer’s conversation.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires inbox.use. Emits call.started.

post.summary: Cancel a call through your own cell before the customer answers: HandsFreeOS hangs it up, and you can call again at once.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits call.bridge_cancelled, call.missed.

post.summary: Set your own cell phone. HandsFreeOS calls it from the business number, and pressing 1 on that call confirms it’s yours. A different number takes the place of the one before, which is no longer verified.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits user_phone.verification_requested.

post.summary: Add the business’s own domain for sending email. HandsFreeOS sets it up with Postmark and shows the DNS records to add.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits email_domain.added.

post.summary: Ask Postmark to check the domain’s DKIM and Return-Path records now. The answer shows in Settings → Email.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits email_domain.verify_requested.

post.summary: Remove one of the business’s domains and the addresses on it. The default address has to live elsewhere first.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits email_domain.removed.

post.summary: Add a sending address on the shared subdomain or on a verified domain of the business’s own, optionally as the default.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits email_address.created.

post.summary: Change the name customers see on an address, rename it while it has not sent mail, or make it the default.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits email_address.updated.

post.summary: Start connecting an Outlook or Gmail mailbox. Returns a one-time state; the browser signs in to Microsoft or Google through the worker.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits mailbox.connect_started.

post.summary: Disconnect a mailbox. HandsFreeOS forgets its sign-in and stops syncing; mail already in the inbox stays.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits mailbox.disconnected.

post.summary: Check a connected mailbox for new mail now instead of waiting for the next sync.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits mailbox.resync_requested.

post.summary: File an email from an unknown sender under a customer. It joins their conversation and timeline.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits email.unmatched_claimed.

post.summary: Dismiss an email from an unknown sender without filing it under anyone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits email.unmatched_dismissed.

post.summary: Stop email to an address. Nothing goes to it until the suppression is released.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits email_suppression.added.

post.summary: Let email go to an address again after a bounce, a spam complaint or a manual stop.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits email_suppression.released.

post.summary: Rename one of your chats with the Assistant.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires assistant.use. Emits .

post.summary: Archive one of your chats so it leaves your chat history.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires assistant.use. Emits .

post.summary: Create a calendar from an answer to "How do you want this calendar to work?". It starts as a draft; the preset only fills in settings.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits calendar.created.

post.summary: Save a calendar’s settings as a new revision. Refuses a stale draft (revision_conflict), setting conflicts on an active calendar (422), and changes that touch upcoming appointments until each has a decision (impact_review_required).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires calendars.manage. Emits calendar.updated, appointment.reassigned, appointment.cancelled.

post.summary: Restore an earlier revision of a calendar’s settings. It is saved again as a new revision, with the same checks as a save.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires calendars.manage. Emits calendar.updated, appointment.reassigned, appointment.cancelled.

post.summary: Activate, pause, archive or return a calendar to draft. Activating needs its settings free of conflicts.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits calendar.status_changed.

post.summary: Change a calendar’s link name. The old link keeps working; /book/c/<id> never changes.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits calendar.slug_changed.

post.summary: Add a service customers can book: one to six lengths, buffers, who does it, what it needs and optional service hours.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits service.created.

post.summary: Change a service: name, lengths, buffers, who does it, what it needs or its hours.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits service.updated.

post.summary: Archive a service. Its appointments keep it; calendars still offering it show a conflict to fix.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits service.archived.

post.summary: Add a room, truck or piece of equipment bookings can reserve, with a quantity and optional hours.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits resource.created.

post.summary: Change a resource’s name, kind, quantity, location or hours.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits resource.updated.

post.summary: Archive a resource. Its appointments keep it; calendars that need it show a conflict to fix.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits resource.archived.

post.summary: Add a service area (territory) and the people who cover it: a list of ZIP codes, so many miles from an address, or a shape drawn on the map.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits territory.created.

post.summary: Rename a service area (territory) or change what it covers (its ZIP codes, distance or drawn shape) or its people.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits territory.updated.

post.summary: Delete a territory. Calendars routing by ZIP stop sending its codes to its people.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits territory.deleted.

post.summary: Set up or change the public booking site (/book/<name>) that lists the public calendars.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires calendars.manage. Emits booking_site.updated.

post.summary: Set weekly hours for yourself, or (owners and admins) for a teammate, resource or service.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits schedule.updated.

post.summary: Add time off (or extra open time) for yourself, or (owners and admins) a teammate, resource or service. All-day dates are read in the schedule’s zone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits time_off.added.

post.summary: Remove time off (or extra open time) from a schedule.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits time_off.removed.

post.summary: Book an appointment on a calendar. Staff hear warnings (buffers, outside hours, busy, time off, in the past) and may book anyway; a real overlap is never allowed.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits appointment.booked. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Change an appointment’s title, notes, location or lead: only what was edited, each with what the editor saw, and the newest change to each wins.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits appointment.updated. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Move an appointment to a new time (and length), keeping who works it. Warnings can be acknowledged; an overlap can’t.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits appointment.rescheduled. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Change who works an appointment (the first person hosts).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits appointment.reassigned.

post.summary: Cancel an appointment for everyone on it, optionally telling the customers.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits appointment.cancelled, waitlist.seat_freed. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Mark an appointment done, or a no-show.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits appointment.completed, appointment.no_show. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Say a visit is running over, so the "How did it go?" push asks again in an hour.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires appointments.write. Emits appointment.still_going. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add a customer to a session or group appointment, if seats are left.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits attendee.added.

post.summary: Take a customer off an appointment (their seats open up).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits attendee.removed, waitlist.seat_freed.

post.summary: Publish a date on a fixed-sessions calendar that customers take seats in.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits session.published.

post.summary: Repeat an appointment (or, on a sessions calendar, a session) weekly or monthly. Books every date that fits and reports the ones that don’t.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits series.created.

post.summary: Cancel one occurrence of a series, it and the ones after it, or every upcoming one.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits series.cancelled.

post.summary: Put a customer on a calendar’s waitlist: for a full session, or for a window they want.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits waitlist.added.

post.summary: Take someone off a waitlist.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits waitlist.removed.

post.summary: Start connecting your own Google or Outlook calendar. Returns a one-time state; the browser signs in to Google or Microsoft through the worker.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits calendar_connection.connect_started.

post.summary: Disconnect a Google or Outlook calendar: your own, or anyone’s for owners and admins. HandsFreeOS forgets the sign-in and stops reading busy times; events it already added stay in that calendar.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires appointments.write. Emits calendar_connection.disconnected.

post.summary: Read your connected calendar’s busy times now instead of waiting for the next check (every 10 minutes).
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits calendar_connection.sync_requested.

post.summary: Create a workflow as an untested draft: blank (with a trigger), from a built-in recipe (with placeholders mapped to this business), or from an AI builder proposal.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.created, workflow_proposal.applied.

post.summary: Save edits to a workflow’s draft as patch ops made against a base revision. A stale base is a 409 revision_conflict; a bad op is a 400 naming its index. Drafts never run.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.draft_saved.

post.summary: Rename a workflow or change its description.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.renamed.

post.summary: Publish the draft as a new, unchangeable version that new runs start on. Needs no blocking issues (422) and a passing test of this exact draft revision (409 not_tested).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.published.

post.summary: Pause a live workflow: nothing new starts (triggers are ignored, not queued) and runs hold at their next step.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.paused.

post.summary: Resume a paused workflow. New triggers start runs again and held runs are released in batches.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.resumed.

post.summary: Archive a workflow. It stops its runs still going; its versions, runs and history stay.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.archived.

post.summary: Copy a published version back into the draft as a new revision. It needs a new test before it can be published.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.draft_saved.

post.summary: Ask for a test run of the draft as it is now: Simulate (sends nothing, fast-forwards waits) or Send to me (sends only to you). A pass lets that revision be published.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.test_requested.

post.summary: Add a customer to a live workflow ("Add to workflow…"). The engine starts the run, keeping to the workflow’s re-entry setting.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits workflow.enrol_requested.

post.summary: Take a customer out of a workflow: their runs still going stop. Owners and admins stop them at once; for anyone else the engine does.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits workflow.contact_removed.

post.summary: Stop one run that is still going. A run that already ended is left as it is.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow_run.stopped.

post.summary: Approve (optionally editing what goes out) or reject a workflow’s approval step. The people it names, or owners and admins, decide; it can be decided once.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.read. Emits workflow.approval_decided. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Ask the engine to run a failed step of a run again.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.step_retry_requested.

post.summary: Ask the engine to skip a failed step of a run and carry on with the next one.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.step_skip_requested.

post.summary: Apply an AI builder proposal: its ops go into the workflow’s draft as one edit (refused when the draft moved on since), or a new workflow is created when the proposal is for one.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow.created, workflow.draft_saved, workflow_proposal.applied.

post.summary: Record that the editor applied an AI builder proposal to a workflow’s draft and saved it (the editor applies the ops itself, as one Undo), so the Assistant no longer offers it. Refused until the draft is saved past the revision it was drafted against.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workflows.manage. Emits workflow_proposal.applied.

post.summary: Save one of your businesses’ workflows as an agency template. Its stages, tags, calendars and people become named placeholders each business maps.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits workflow_template.created.

post.summary: Publish a template’s current draft as its next version. Businesses on an older version see “Update available”.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits workflow_template.published.

post.summary: Push a template’s newest version to client businesses with each one’s placeholder mapping. The engine installs a draft in each; each business still tests before publishing.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits workflow_template.pushed.

post.summary: Save edits to an agency template’s draft as patch ops made against a base revision, as workflow drafts save. A stale base is a 409 revision_conflict; a bad op is a 400 naming its index. Publishing makes it the version businesses get.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits workflow_template.draft_saved.

post.summary: Start an agency template from scratch: a blank draft with its trigger (by hand when none is given) and no steps, to build, publish and push to client businesses.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits workflow_template.created.

post.summary: Rename an agency template or change its description. Businesses’ installed copies keep their own names.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits workflow_template.renamed.

post.summary: Build an agency starter pack of FAQs, articles and facts (for example “HVAC FAQs”) to push to client businesses as suggestions.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits knowledge_pack.created.

post.summary: Change a starter pack’s name, description or items, or archive it. Every change raises its version.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits knowledge_pack.updated.

post.summary: Push a starter pack to client businesses. Each gets its items as suggestions to accept, edit or reject.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires org.templates.manage. Emits knowledge_pack.pushed.

post.summary: Save the business profile the AI writes from: what you do, services, area, hours, policies, tone of voice, words to use and avoid, signature, and whether AI may quote prices.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge.profile_updated.

post.summary: Add an FAQ, article or fact to the knowledge base, as a draft or published.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_item.created.

post.summary: Change an item’s text, title or question, tags, or kind (an FAQ, article or fact; a document stays a document).
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_item.updated.

post.summary: Publish an item so AI steps and the Assistant can use it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_item.published.

post.summary: Archive an item: the AI stops using it. Run logs keep pointing at it; publish it again to bring it back.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_item.archived.

post.summary: Add an offer the business is running, with when it starts and ends. The AI teammate tells customers about it while it runs.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits offer.created.

post.summary: Change an offer’s name, details or dates.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits offer.updated.

post.summary: Take an offer off the list. The AI teammate stops mentioning it at once.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits offer.archived.

post.summary: Import FAQs from a spreadsheet (question, answer, optional tags; up to 500 rows). Questions the knowledge base already has are skipped.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_item.imported.

post.summary: Reserve a place for a PDF or text file (5 MB at most) in the knowledge base. Upload it to the returned path, confirm it with file.confirm, then add it with knowledge_document.add.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits .

post.summary: Add an uploaded PDF or text file to the knowledge base. Its text becomes a draft document item to review and publish.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_document.added.

post.summary: Set the business’s website address for “Scan our website” (https only; one website per business).
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_source.set.

post.summary: Scan the business’s website: the engine reads its pages and proposes facts, FAQs and articles to accept. One scan at a time.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_scan.requested.

post.summary: Accept a suggestion (from a website scan, a question the AI couldn’t answer, or an agency pack), with any edits. It becomes an item, or updates the item a rescan changed.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_suggestion.accepted, knowledge_item.created, knowledge_item.updated.

post.summary: Reject a suggestion. Nothing is added to the knowledge base.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits knowledge_suggestion.rejected.

post.summary: Record a lead’s answers to the business’s qualifying questions, in the customer’s words. When they qualify the lead, lead.qualified goes out.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits lead.answers_recorded, lead.qualified. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Take a conversation from the AI teammate (or from “Needs a person”): the teammate stays quiet until someone hands it back, and its pending reply is dropped.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.taken_over. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Hand a conversation back to the AI teammate. It answers what’s waiting and whatever the customer writes next.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.handed_to_ai. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Set up the business’s AI teammate from a preset (or blank), with its name and how it says it’s AI. It starts off; turn it on when its settings are ready.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires ai_team.manage. Emits ai_teammate.created.

post.summary: Save the AI teammate’s settings as a new revision. Refuses a stale draft (revision_conflict); settings conflicts never block a save, only turning it on.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires ai_team.manage. Emits ai_teammate.config_saved.

post.summary: Bring back an earlier revision of the AI teammate’s settings. It’s saved again as a new revision; its training progress stays as it is.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires ai_team.manage. Emits ai_teammate.config_saved.

post.summary: Turn the AI teammate off, put it in training (every message waits for a person’s OK), or make it automatic (“Switch to automatic now”). Turning it on is refused while its settings conflict; “Back to training” starts the count again.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires ai_team.manage. Emits ai_teammate.status_changed.

post.summary: Approve (optionally editing the message) or reject one of the AI teammate’s drafts, once. A reply draft counts toward training; an approved draft then goes out as the teammate with your name on it.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires inbox.use. Emits ai_teammate.draft_decided, ai_teammate.status_changed. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Ask the AI teammate for a new reply after you rejected its draft. It answers the same messages again with your reason in mind, and the new draft waits for an OK.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits ai_teammate.retry_requested.

post.summary: Move a job along: on the way (with where you are, for an arrival time), started, waiting on parts, done, or back to scheduled, with an optional note the customer may see. The customer gets a text about it when they can.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits job.status_changed. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Make a job a project: add another of the same customer’s visits to it. A job the visit leaves with no visits of its own is removed.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits job.visit_added.

post.summary: Add a way for leads to arrive from outside: a form on the business’s own website (returns a public key for the page, and the sites it may be posted from), or a connected app like Zapier (returns a secret key, shown this once).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits intake_source.created.

post.summary: Change how leads arrive: whether a channel, a website form or a connected app opens a customer and a lead, what that lead is filed under, which pipeline and stage it lands in, how many a day, and — for a form — the sites it may be posted from and where its sender goes afterwards. Only the fields sent change.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits intake_source.updated.

post.summary: Give a website form a new public key, or a connected app a new secret key. Every copy of the old one stops working at once — the form on the site needs the new key pasted in, and the app needs its key changed.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits intake_source.key_rotated.

post.summary: Retire a website form or a connected app. Its key stops working and nothing more arrives through it; the customers and leads it opened stay where they are.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits intake_source.archived.

post.summary: Add a website chat widget: the sites it shows on (the www version is added for you), how it looks, who answers, and what it asks visitors for. Returns the public key for the snippet.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits chat_widget.created.

post.summary: Change a website chat widget: its sites, look, greeting and away message, who answers, what it asks visitors for, SMS consent and daily limit. Only the fields sent change.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits chat_widget.updated.

post.summary: Pause a website chat widget: visitors can’t start or send chats until it’s resumed. The snippet can stay on the site.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits chat_widget.paused.

post.summary: Turn a paused website chat widget back on.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires channels.manage. Emits chat_widget.resumed.

post.summary: Give a website chat widget a new public key. Every snippet pasted before stops working, so paste the new one.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits chat_widget.key_rotated.

post.summary: Block a website chat visitor so they can’t send more messages. With `network`, everyone on their network is blocked here for 7 days too.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires inbox.use. Emits chat.visitor_blocked.

post.summary: Let a blocked website chat visitor chat again, lifting any block on their network that came with it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits chat.visitor_unblocked.

post.summary: Put an attention item out of sight until a time (up to 30 days). It comes back then, or sooner if its facts change.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires records.write. Emits attention.snoozed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Bring a snoozed attention item back now. The worker runs it when a snooze runs out (and leaves one that was snoozed again for later).
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires records.write. Emits attention.unsnoozed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Say an attention item doesn’t need doing, with an optional reason. It comes back only if its facts change.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires records.write. Emits attention.dismissed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Undo a snooze or a dismissal: the item is open again.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires records.write. Emits attention.restored. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Give an attention item to a teammate, or leave it for anyone. For a lead, a conversation or a task it changes who owns that record; an appointment’s or an approval’s item is assigned on its own.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits attention.assigned. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Let HandsFreeOS handle an attention item. A confirmation request or a follow-up nudge is queued (it goes after a short cancel window); for anything else, pick what to do (hand the conversation to the AI teammate, reply, or set the next action) and it’s done in your name.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits attention.handle_requested, attention.handled. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Stop an automatic message (a confirmation request or a follow-up nudge) that is waiting to go out.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires records.write. Emits attention.auto_cancelled. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Save the Action Center’s settings: which kinds are on, thresholds, the typical job value, stale days per stage, the automatic switches, the follow-up message and replying C to confirm. Turning nudges on (“Looks good, turn on”) records that the message was read.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.update. Emits attention.settings_saved.

Hi {firstName}, it's {senderName} at {businessName}. Just checking in: are you still looking for help? Reply here and we'll take it from there.

post.summary: Save Settings → Automations’ own switches and timings: the day-before and day-of reminders, waitlist offers, the morning email, and re-engaging dead leads with its message. Turning re-engaging on (“Looks good, turn on”) records that the message was read.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.update. Emits automations.settings_saved.

template.default: Hi {firstName}, it's {businessName}. Your {service} is due soon. Book a time that suits you here: {link}

post.summary: Turn somebody a customer mentioned into a customer and a lead, with the customer who mentioned them as its source. Finds them first if their phone or email is already here.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits referral.lead_created.

post.summary: Add the line of guidance made of repeated corrections to the AI teammate to the business’s policies, which the AI reads on every reply.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires knowledge.manage. Emits teammate_lesson.applied, knowledge.profile_updated.

post.summary: Set how often one customer is due for a service (every N months), stop reminding them ("never"), or go back to what their plan or the service says ("default").
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits maintenance.schedule_set.

post.summary: Move a deal to the stage that matches what happened to it (a quote sent, a visit booked, a quote accepted or a job done). Forward only.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits .

post.summary: Mark a booking confirmed for the customer (they said so on the phone, say), or take back a confirmation someone on the team marked. A customer’s own confirmation stays.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires appointments.write. Emits attendee.confirmed, attendee.confirmation_removed. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Add something to sell: a part, work done, or a charge like a call-out fee, with its unit price, what one unit is called and whether it is taxed. It can be the price of a bookable service.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits product.created.

post.summary: Change something in the catalogue. Repricing it never reprices a document that has already gone out: every line keeps what the product said when it was added.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits product.updated.

post.summary: Stop selling something, or put it back. Nothing in the catalogue is ever deleted: archiving keeps every old document readable, and frees the name for a new item.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits product.archived, product.restored.

post.summary: Add a maintenance plan to sell: what it costs, how often it bills and what the customer gets. Selling it takes a copy, so repricing the plan never reprices a customer already on it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits plan.created.

post.summary: Change a maintenance plan in the catalogue. Customers already on it keep the price they were sold.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits plan.updated.

post.summary: Stop selling a maintenance plan, or put it back. Customers already on it keep billing: their subscription holds its own copy.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits plan.archived, plan.restored.

post.summary: Start connecting a Stripe or Square account to be paid into. Returns a one-time state; the browser signs in at the provider through the worker. A business can have several accounts connected at once.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits payment_connection.connect_started.

post.summary: Rename a connected payment account, so a business tells its own accounts apart.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits payment_connection.renamed.

post.summary: Choose which connected account new invoices are paid into. One default per business and environment.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits payment_connection.default_set.

post.summary: Disconnect a payment account. HandsFreeOS forgets the sign-in and stops taking money into it; payments already on their way still settle, and reconnecting the same account restores refunds on old payments. Plans billing through it keep billing at the provider, so this refuses and lists them until you say you know.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires money.manage. Emits payment_connection.disconnected, subscription.unmanaged.

post.summary: Start an estimate for a customer: its lines from the catalogue or typed by hand, a discount, and what to ask for up front if they say yes. It stays a draft until it is sent.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits estimate.created.

post.summary: Save a draft estimate: its header and all of its lines at once, against the revision you loaded. Someone else’s save in between is kept and yours is refused. A sent estimate can’t be edited — void it and reissue.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits estimate.updated.

post.summary: Send an estimate to the customer. It takes the next number, stamps when it went out and freezes: from here its number, its tax, its totals and its lines are what the customer was shown. The worker sends the text or the email with the link.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits estimate.sent. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Record that the customer said yes — on the phone, or in person. It is marked as recorded by staff, in your name, and never as the customer’s own approval.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits estimate.accepted.

post.summary: Turn an estimate into an invoice. The lines are copied as they were agreed and the deposit is carried through as what to ask for first; ask for the deposit on its own and it is raised as a one-line deposit invoice instead.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits estimate.converted.

post.summary: Withdraw an estimate. Its number is kept and never used again — the gap is the record — and nothing about it can change afterwards.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits estimate.voided.

post.summary: Start an invoice for a customer: its lines, a discount, what it is for and which connected account it is paid into. It stays a draft until it is sent. A deposit at booking, a plan’s cycle and a quick payment all make one of these.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits invoice.created.

post.summary: Save a draft invoice: its header and all of its lines at once, against the revision you loaded. A sent invoice can’t be edited — void it and reissue, so it says the same thing next year.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires money.manage. Emits invoice.updated.

post.summary: Send an invoice to the customer. It takes the next number, works out its due date from the business’s terms if it hasn’t got one, stamps when it went out and freezes. The worker sends the text or the email with the link they pay on.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits invoice.sent. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Withdraw an invoice. Its number is kept and never used again. Money paid on it is refunded first — the money moved, and the ledger has to say so — and once everything paid has been given back it can be voided and a new invoice sent in its place.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits invoice.voided.

post.summary: Record money taken off the system: cash, a cheque, or another way. It lands as a payment in your name and the invoice recounts itself — nobody marks an invoice paid by hand.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits payment.recorded, invoice.paid. Can wait on a phone with no signal.

post.summary: Give money back on a payment, all of it or part. The worker calls the provider and records what came back; the invoice recounts itself. Refused when the account it was taken through is no longer connected — reconnect it, or refund it at the provider.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires money.manage. Emits refund.requested.

post.summary: Put a customer on a maintenance plan. The plan is copied as it is sold today, so repricing the catalogue never reprices them. It starts as a draft; the worker sets it up at the provider and the first cycle makes it live.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires money.manage. Emits subscription.started.

post.summary: Pause a plan: nothing is billed until it is resumed. The worker pauses it at the provider too.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits subscription.paused.

post.summary: Start a paused plan billing again, from the next cycle.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits subscription.resumed.

post.summary: Ask the customer to put a card on their plan, by text, by email, or just to get the link. The plan waits until they do; asking again keeps the same link working.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits subscription.card_requested. Can wait on a phone for 30 minutes, then asks.

post.summary: Change which connected account a plan bills through. Only a plan the provider does not hold yet, or one left unmanaged when its account went away: a live plan lives inside one provider account and cannot be moved, so that is cancelled and started again instead.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits subscription.connection_changed.

post.summary: End a plan. The worker cancels it at the provider, so nothing is billed again; what has already been billed stays on the ledger.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires money.manage. Emits subscription.cancelled.

post.summary: Turn automatic top-up on or off, and set the balance it happens at, how much it adds, and how far the balance may go under before outbound texts and calls stop.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits wallet.settings_changed.

post.summary: Start putting a card on the wallet. The worker opens the page the card is typed on; nothing about the card is ever written here.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits wallet.card_requested.

post.summary: Take the card off the wallet. Automatic top-up goes off with it, because a top-up with nothing to charge is a promise nobody can keep.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires money.manage. Emits wallet.card_forgotten.

post.summary: Add money to the balance now, from the card on file. A top-up somebody asked for never raises the automatic amount.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires money.manage. Emits wallet.recharge_requested.

post.summary: Support: put a credit on a business’s balance, or take one back, with a reason. It shows on their statement like everything else.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires platform.wallets.adjust. Emits wallet.adjusted.

post.summary: Support: move one business along the usage wallet — silent, warned, or stopped when the balance runs out.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires platform.wallets.adjust. Emits wallet.stage_changed.

post.summary: Approve an application and hold a seat for that business. Returns the claim link, once. The seat is theirs until the link expires.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires platform.founding.manage. Emits founding.approved.

post.summary: Turn an application down, with a note only staff ever see.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires platform.founding.manage. Emits founding.declined.

post.summary: Put an application on the waitlist, to be approved if a seat frees up.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires platform.founding.manage. Emits founding.waitlisted.

post.summary: Take up an approved free seat: this workspace gets its founding plan and its starting usage credit. A paid seat is taken up by paying for it (founding.start_checkout).
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires workspace.update. Emits founding.claimed.

post.summary: Start paying for an approved paid seat, or pick up the payment already under way. The worker makes the Stripe page; ask founding.checkout_status for its address.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires workspace.update. Emits founding.checkout_requested.

post.summary: Take a founding seat back. The seat is free for somebody else at once; the business keeps working until its grace period ends.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires platform.founding.manage. Emits founding.revoked.

post.summary: Undo a revocation. Refused if the seat has since been given to somebody else — there is no room to put them back into.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires platform.founding.manage. Emits founding.restored.

post.summary: Change how many seats an offer has. Raising it opens seats; it cannot go below the number already out.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires platform.founding.manage. Emits founding.cap_changed.

post.summary: Open an offer to applications, close it, or put it back in draft so nobody sees it at all.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires platform.founding.manage. Emits founding.status_changed.

post.summary: Save the money settings: the sales tax and what it is called, invoice and estimate numbering, payment terms and notes, how long an estimate stays good, the deposit to ask for, whether bank transfer is offered, and when reminders go out. The next number only ever moves forward.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires money.manage. Emits money.settings_saved.

estimate.default: Thanks for the opportunity. Call or text us with any questions.
Thanks for the opportunity. Call or text us with any questions.

post.summary: Get push notifications on this phone: registers its Expo push token for you, or refreshes it. Anyone else who signed in on this phone stops getting theirs here.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits push_device.registered.

post.summary: Stop push notifications on one of your phones: this one when you sign out or turn them off here, or another one from your list. Already off, nothing changes.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits push_device.removed.

post.summary: Start connecting the CRM a business is leaving. Returns a one-time state; the browser either signs in at that system through the worker, or posts a private token to the worker. No token ever passes through here. The scan that follows only ever reads.
post.description: Risk level 2. Emits migration_connection.connect_started.

post.summary: Rename a connected source, so an agency tells two of them apart.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires org.migrations.manage. Emits migration_connection.renamed.

post.summary: Disconnect the old system. Everything already brought across stays; any migration still catching up stops catching up. The old account itself is never touched.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires org.migrations.manage. Emits migration_connection.disconnected, migration.needs_attention.

post.summary: Start a migration from a connected source. Nothing is read or written until it is scanned and somebody chooses what to bring.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits migration.created.

post.summary: Look at the old system and count what is there. Read-only, and safe to run again: nothing it does can change a customer record.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits migration.scan_requested.

post.summary: Say where each sub-account of the old system lands: a new business here, one that already exists, or nowhere. Several may land in the same business, and the plan says what that mixes.
post.description: Risk level 3. Emits migration.scopes_mapped, workspace.created.

post.summary: Choose what to bring across. Anything a choice needs is added automatically and locked, with a line saying which choice asked for it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits migration.selection_changed.

post.summary: Bring it across. Queues the work in dependency order; nothing outside this business is ever contacted, and no message, invoice or reminder goes out because of it.
post.description: Risk level 4. Emits migration.started.

post.summary: Stop after the batch that is running. Nothing already brought across is undone, and resuming carries on from the same place.
post.description: Risk level 2. Emits migration.paused.

post.summary: Carry on from the last place that was safely saved.
post.description: Risk level 2. Emits migration.resumed.

post.summary: Try the failures again. Records that already came across are not brought twice — the source identity sees to that.
post.description: Risk level 2. Emits migration.retry_requested.

post.summary: Keep catching up with the old system for longer. It never stops quietly: when the time runs out the migration asks.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires org.migrations.manage. Emits migration.transition_extended.

post.summary: Finish the move: one last catch-up, the checks, and then the old system stops being asked. It never cancels the old account for you.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires org.migrations.manage. Emits migration.finalize_requested.

post.summary: Take back what this migration put here. Customers who were already here are never deleted, and anything somebody has changed since is left exactly as they left it.
post.description: Risk level 4. Emits migration.rollback_requested.

post.summary: Take a move off the list: one that never put anything here goes straight away, and one that did has to be taken back first so the import can be run again from scratch. Customers with history here are kept.
post.description: Risk level 4. Emits migration.deleted.

post.summary: Say whether somebody arriving from the old system is somebody already here, or a different person.
post.description: Risk level 2. Emits migration.merge_resolved.

post.summary: Tick off a setup step, such as reconnecting Stripe or changing a DNS record.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits migration.task_changed.

post.description: Risk level 2. Requires support.reply. Emits support_ticket.replied.

post.summary: Move a ticket to another status: open, waiting, solved or closed.

post.summary: Set how urgent a ticket is.

post.summary: Give a ticket to someone, or put it back in the unassigned queue.

post.summary: Put a ticket down until a time you choose. It comes back by itself.

post.summary: Fold one ticket into another when the same person wrote twice about the same thing.

post.summary: Throw away the AI’s suggested answer for this ticket.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires support.reply. Emits support_ticket.draft_dismissed.

post.summary: Cancel a support invitation so its link no longer works.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires platform.staff.manage. Emits support_staff.invitation_revoked.

post.summary: Accept a support invitation. Works once, for the address it was sent to.

post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits .
